Requirement links identify partial source-backed input coverage and relevant limitations, not completed requirements or modeling eligibility. Group summaries cannot establish individual variability. Summary definitions, sampling schedules and low-dose near-axis readings require review.

evidence.quote: Plasma voriconazole after oral gavage, infected mice (digitized means and error-bar ends)
S03 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.00606-10 | Fig. 2 (Mavridou et al. 2010)

Female CD-1 mice 20-22 g, 4-5 weeks, NON-neutropenic; disseminated aspergillosis (A. fumigatus AZN 8196 i.v.). Voriconazole oral solution by gavage once daily, 10, 40 or 80 mg/kg, from 24 h after infection. PK blood sampled on DAY 2 OF TREATMENT (methods: "immediately before administration of voriconazole and at 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, and 24 h postdosing"; text: "8 time points"), 3 mice per time point, lithium-heparin plasma, HPLC-fluorescence, LLOQ 0.01 mg/liter for low concentrations.

Caption: each symbol is the geometric mean and standard deviation of plasma levels for three mice; methods say arithmetic means were calculated. The plotted times (0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 h; axis ends at 15 h) differ from the sampling times in the methods.
Digitized from a 400-dpi render; linear y axis calibrated on ticks 0-50 mg/L, x on ticks 0-15 h; checked against Table 2 Cmax (1.61, 11.81, 35.86 mg/liter). Reading uncertainty about ±0.2 mg/L.

At 0 h the three markers overlap at about 0-1.5 mg/L and were not digitized. The lines continue past 12 h to the axis edge without a marker. Error-bar ends are given only where the bar extends beyond the marker; empty means hidden inside the marker.
10 mg/kg markers at 8 and 12 h are centred on the x axis (read as 0); Table 2 gives Cmin 0.36 mg/liter for this dose. These are digitized means, not individual mice.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T1:A4 states that the caption uses geometric mean and standard deviation, whereas the methods calculated arithmetic means. The meaning of the mean columns and associated error bars remains CONFLICT; neither definition was adopted.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported reconciliation of the caption and methods, including which summary definition applies to Fig. 2 and what the displayed error bars represent.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T1:A3 reports predose sampling and 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9 and 24 h postdosing, with text stating 8 time points. A4 describes plotted times of 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 12 h. The table retains its supplied times; actual versus nominal timing and the relation between predose and 0 h are unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Reconciliation of methods, figure timing and digitized row assignments, retaining the original coordinates and both reported schedules.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T1:B13 and B14 contain 0. A7 explicitly identifies these as near-axis digitized readings at 8 and 12 h and also reports Table 2 Cmin 0.36 mg/liter for 10 mg/kg. A5 gives reading uncertainty about ±0.2 mg/L; A3 gives LLOQ 0.01 mg/liter for low concentrations. The readings do not establish measured biological zeros or BLQ classifications, and the relationship to the reported Cmin is unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the low-dose markers and the reported Cmin definition and window. Preserve the supplied zeros, reported Cmin and LLOQ separately without replacement, conversion or imputed censoring flags.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include source identity, oral dosing, treatment day, plasma matrix, HPLC-fluorescence assay, units, group summaries, extraction provenance and an LLOQ. Overall record eligibility remains UNRESOLVED. Total versus unbound basis, salt versus free-base dose basis, complete administered dose history, individual identifiers and actual versus nominal timing are NOT_FOUND. Meningitis, grapefruit-juice exposure and comedication are unspecified rather than established absent. Missing error-bar cells mean hidden endpoints according to A6, not zero SD.
findings.needed_material: Preparation assessment retaining these unknowns and the source conflicts; obtain source-backed definitions where required for the intended use. Do not infer absent treatments or manufacture identifiers, uncertainty values or dose events.

findings.reason: The concentration rows are digitized group means with three mice per time point, not individual records. A6 says 0 h markers were not digitized and continuations beyond 12 h lack markers. Error-bar columns contain endpoints only where visible; they are not standalone SD values. Individual sampling relationships and complete uncertainty information are NOT_FOUND. Input sufficiency and design-permitted evaluation remain downstream questions.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the plotted observation coverage, missing-marker explanations, digitization uncertainty and partial error-bar endpoints. Resolve summary and timing conflicts before preparing affected records; assess sampling design and uncertainty support before modeling.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE dose-level contrasts are 10, 40 and 80 mg/kg in the stated once-daily, treatment-day-2 context. This item does not supply complete prior administered events or separate single-dose and repeated-day concentration profiles. It therefore does not establish a longitudinal treatment-day contrast, time-dependent clearance or a nonlinear mechanism.
findings.needed_material: Complete source-linked dose histories and any eligible treatment-day or single-versus-repeat contrasts needed by the later animal PK assessment. Keep current dose groups and treatment day separate without transferring parameters.

findings.reason: Forwarded unchanged in status and scope from main:/missing_information/items/4: field Source-block preparation and record eligibility; status DEFERRED; needed_at prepare; resolution_status OPEN. A usable modeling dataset and its unresolved record-level limitations have not been established by this transformation. This item-level label does not close MI005.
findings.needed_material: Perform the authorized SC021 assessment and document eligible records and independently identified gaps without assuming completeness.

findings.reason: Forwarded unchanged in status and scope from main:/missing_information/items/5: field Animal PK model support and design-permitted evaluation; status DEFERRED; needed_at pk; resolution_status OPEN. SC022 makes model choices and evaluation conditional on data and design support; the proposal does not supply that assessment. Supported mouse and rat model structures and permitted predictive checks cannot yet be determined. For DRQ006, this source supplies mouse study context but does not establish rat coverage, structural support, holdout units or model evaluation.
findings.needed_material: Assess the prepared evidence for the conditional choices in SC022 and retain unsupported or unassessable components as limitations.

findings.reason: Forwarded unchanged in status and scope from main:/missing_information/items/6: field Support for individual PK variability; status DEFERRED; needed_at pk; resolution_status OPEN. The proposal distinguishes summaries and predictions from individual observations and prohibits invented variability in SC027 and SC038; attachment-level support remains unassessed in the originating record. Individual variability cannot be used defensibly in animal modeling or carried into human simulations until its evidential basis is established. For DRQ009, A7 explicitly identifies these records as digitized means, not individual mice; the sample count and error bars do not establish individual trajectories or animal random effects.
findings.needed_material: Determine whether authorized individual-level evidence supports variability estimation; otherwise preserve the limitation without constructing variability from summaries.

findings.reason: A3 provides a source-linked mouse study body-weight range of 20-22 g and explicit sex, age, immune and infection context. This is candidate mouse coverage only. The item does not provide a cross-species parameter inventory, individual weights, or approach-specific translation corrections and calibration inputs. Reported Cmax and Cmin values do not qualify a species model or human extrapolation.
findings.needed_material: Reuse the study-specific weight range and biological context in the later translation inventory; assess additional body-size or correction inputs only for explicitly considered approaches, preserving parameter definitions, dose and treatment day.

findings.reason: Forwarded unchanged in status and scope from main:/missing_information/items/9: field Eligible matched PK/PD records; status DEFERRED; needed_at index; resolution_status OPEN. SC024 and SC032 depend on eligibility and matched inputs. The proposal describes relevant resources but does not establish record-level matching or adequacy; attachment bodies were not assessed in the originating record. Comparable index regressions and supported targets cannot yet be established. This item supplies PK context but no measured PD response or matched isolate MIC.
findings.needed_material: Establish eligible matched records for each organism and endpoint under SC017, SC032 and SC033, or document why an index or target is not determinable.

findings.reason: A3 identifies A. fumigatus AZN 8196 and the infection and dosing context, but measured PD responses, matched isolate MIC values, response identifiers, endpoint windows and a source-supported exposure-response relationship are NOT_FOUND in this item. Strain identity alone does not establish MIC or response matching. No DRQ021 match is claimed.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked response records, isolate MICs and measurement context, endpoint windows, free-exposure basis and documented matching to the relevant dosing and PK records. Retain this gap without blocking independent PK input assessment.

findings.reason: No AUC value, free-AUC definition, AUC integration window or matched isolate MIC is provided in this item. The digitized concentration curves are candidate PK inputs, but they do not establish an available fAUC/MIC input or a completed derivation. Response matching is also NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: A source-supported free-AUC input or documented later derivation from eligible PK inputs, with its window, time origin, units, binding basis, matched isolate MIC and response endpoint.

findings.reason: A5 reports Table 2 Cmax values of 1.61, 11.81 and 35.86 mg/liter as digitization checks. The note does not explicitly assign each value to a dose, define the peak window or establish a free-concentration basis. These reported values remain distinct from the digitized concentration rows. Matched isolate MICs and response records are NOT_FOUND, so fCmax/MIC matching is not established.
findings.needed_material: Confirmation of the reported Cmax dose associations, peak definition and window, free-exposure basis, matched isolate MIC and response endpoint. Do not assign the listed values to doses solely from their order.

findings.reason: Digitized plasma profiles are available, but free-concentration status, the matched isolate MIC threshold, analysis-window boundaries, duration-versus-percentage definition and any percentage denominator are NOT_FOUND in this item. The missing 0 h digitization and conflicting sampling schedules also limit profile-window definition. No fT>MIC input or result is established.
findings.needed_material: A defined free-concentration profile input, matched isolate MIC and measurement context, analysis window and time origin, output definition, and source-supported regimen-response matching. Resolve relevant timing and digitization limitations before downstream index calculation.
